newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Mast shares jump on strong interim results.
newsitem.headline: Mast shares jump on strong interim results.

text.p: Mast Holdings shares leapt on Thursday after the company reported a 50 percent increase in interim results compared to the 13 months ended August 31, 1996, dealers said.
The company is 78.25 percent owned by Advanced Technical Systems Ltd which also posted a 129 percent rise in year earnings per share.
"Mast is up on the results. Their holding in Advtech also boosts them," a dealer said.
Mast reached a high of 108 cents before settling 8.33 percent higher at 104 cents in thin volume. Advtech rose five cents to 795 cents also in thin volume.
Mast said a direct comparison between the two reporting periods was difficult due to the cyclical nature of some of the divisions and the inclusion of Advtech subsidiaries with effect from March 1.
Advtech itself said prospects for the current year were positive with the group positioned as a leading player in the private education sector following recent acquisitions.
